en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a wide, busy boulevard lined with multi‑storey historic buildings and tram tracks. Crowds of people, several trams, and what appears to be a marching formation fill the street. In the foreground stands a monument with a sculpted figure on a pedestal. Church or clock towers rise in the background. The caption at the top reads "Dresden. Hauptstrasse." and a small imprint with publisher information appears near the bottom edge.
